assets.description: Exactly one persimmon-orange five-point paper star cutout, flat front view, slightly rounded outline. Very clear silhouette at tiny size.
Exactly one closed dark blue-green children's hardback book from near overhead with a cream white page edge and one small solid apricot cover motif; compact, easy to tell from a ruler, no words.
Exactly one straight yellow wooden school ruler with simple short dark graduation strokes but no printed numbers. Show one full horizontal ruler, centered and visually separate from everything else.
Exactly one saturated teal-green cut-paper leaf with a single clear central vein, compact oval shape and a small tip, no other leaves.
Exactly one small warm cream and apricot toy van, straight overhead, oriented to the right, dark pine outline, front and back visually clear, two chunky slate wheels.
Exactly one warm cream and apricot toy van identical to the above, overhead facing right, with a small visible mint flag folded tightly on its roof, no letters and no marks.
Exactly one small purple wooden wagon moving horizontally, overhead straight-on, with dark wheels and one closed plum cargo box. Purple is distinctly different from the cream and apricot van.
One compact empty warm cream paper craft board on a pine green mount, a tiny orange corner tab and two short washi strips, tilted very slightly, no marks or text, original classroom display prop.
One small finished apricot exhibition rosette sticker with a pine center and two short warm cream ribbon tails, no text and no glyphs. Crisp silhouette.
